definitions.time: Post-physics samples; first sample at 0.02 s. Segment-relative times.
definitions.moving: 1 s windows ending at >=2 s; bad window counts overlap and are not independent observations.
definitions.zero: Same 100-sample exclusion as frozen assess; samples 2.02..12.00 s, 500 required.
definitions.missing: Incomplete/unsafe remain in episode totals; missing segments cannot be a zero pass.
definitions.stable_suffix: Observed suffix only; may last less than 10 s and does not replace the zero gate.
definitions.causality: No observations/actions/joint/torque time series retained; cannot infer actuator or reward causes.

unsafe.note: Episode-wide extrema are not values at the unsafe instant; joint/action time series absent.
